evals.prompt: Draft the app release notes for v2.2.2-rc.13 using the release materials in /workspace/input. Return the notes in chat.
evals.expected_output: Two concise changes: the date picker is disabled for single-day schedules and chat reactions use neutral colors.
assertions: Covers both listed changes and preserves the single-day condition.
Includes no claims about Timeline creation, join controls, notification preferences or draft retention from the implementation comparison.
Attributes no unlisted user benefit or behavior to either change.

evals.prompt: Write customer notes for 1.4.0. Its changelog has one entry under Fixes: “Keep the selected date and time zone when reopening a booking.”
evals.expected_output: One fix covering both the date and time zone when reopening a booking.
assertions: Presents date and time zone together as one fix, retaining the condition that the booking is reopened.
Adds no unlisted platform, cause, or effect.

evals.prompt: Draft notes for 1.4.1-rc.2. The generated changelog contains the version heading and no entries for this RC.
evals.expected_output: A brief statement that the changelog lists no changes for this RC.
assertions: Reports that the changelog lists no changes without implying that the code did not change.
Introduces no release items and does not ask to inspect commits, code, or tests.
